candidates.title_or_work_label: MALLKUANKA—Vuelo Surnorte De Colores / The South-North Flight of Colors
candidates.street_address_or_precise_public_locatio: Washington Avenue and S. 26th Street, Point Breeze, Philadelphia, PA 19146
candidates.access_notes: Mural Arts lists the mural as On View. Its page locates the work along Washington Avenue on the PASE building.
candidates.work_status: On View, according to Mural Arts Philadelphia.
candidates.artist_evidence_note: Mural Arts lists Roberto Mamani Mamani and Efrain Herrera and describes Mamani Mamani as an Aymara Bolivian artist of Aymara Indigenous descent.
candidates.location_evidence_note: Mural Arts lists Washington Avenue and S. 26th Street and supplies the recorded coordinates in its location link.
candidates.community_context_display: Aymara Bolivian artist; Aymara Indigenous descent; Andean cosmovision
candidates.community_context_evidence_note: Mural Arts identifies Roberto Mamani Mamani as Aymara Bolivian and of Aymara Indigenous descent; it describes Bolivian landscapes and Andean cosmovision. The documented Indigenous context is retained without assigning a generic Hispanic/Latine tag.
candidates.source_rights_note: The Mural Arts project page is a factual source only. Its imagery and media are not licensed to MWM by this manifest.
candidates.missing_evidence_reason: A complete Tier 2 record requires an independent Tier 1 or second independent corroborating source for future owner review; the current metadata/route gap also blocks import.

coverage_note: This review manifest does not assign a cultural tag to any candidate without explicit source support. Additional verified Hispanic/Latine records are a collection-coverage need, not evidence of an absence of public art.
